due_when.clears_when: /api/bot/health/infra reports kaggle and hugging_face from a probe or mirror taken within the last hour (detail no longer says 'not a live probe'), and testing-queue hf_jobs.read_state is `read`; or a decision is recorded that the record-derived reading is enough

observation.what: hugging_face/kaggle detail still says 'not a live probe' and hf_jobs is still could_not_look

origin.rerun: curl -s https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/health/infra | python3 -m json.tool ; curl -s https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/work/testing-queue | python3 -m json.tool  # look for hugging_face/kaggle detail text and hf_jobs.read_state

what: Make Kaggle and Hugging Face observable for the SPA health bar and testing-queue card. /api/bot/health/infra currently derives `kaggle` from comms/backups/kaggle_latest.json and `hugging_face` from comms/data_lake/health_latest.json (workflow records, not live probes; the HF record was 10 days old on 2026-11-12), and /api/bot/work/testing-queue reports hf_jobs as could_not_look because no HF job state is mirrored to the live VM. Build either a live reachability probe (Kaggle API / HF Hub, off the request path, result written to a runtime_logs state file) or a job-state mirror, then read it in routers/infra_status.py. Landed with PR #25231 (UI-SPA-BACKEND-ROUTES).
